title: Scoped synthetic customs refund product
applicability: Only the named synthetic benchmark product and its published customer records; no claim of real law or present provider availability.
content:
This fictional Customs Return product is separate from generic tax-refund receipt products. It does not claim that any present IEEPA rule applies. Importer of record must own entries and register a same-name ACH destination using register_customs_refund_account. submit_customs_refund_claim needs customs_schedule upload, incurs filing fee, and gets a fixed entry-level authority review. accept_customs_award can accept the reviewed eligible total or irrevocably withdraw. Brokers may prepare evidence but do not own the refund. Entry eligibility is not authoritative until the customs review publishes eligible and exclusion details. The accept_customs_award request must bind the exact reviewed amount_minor; customer approval cannot predetermine the authority result. Alternate same-name corporate ACH destinations are permitted when the customer accepts either. Submitted evidence must have a matching intrinsic document_type in its actual contents; relabeling another existing file is insufficient. Tax appointments bind principal company, agent legal name, jurisdiction and signature. Overpayment statements bind company, period, original payment and claimed excess. Customs schedules bind importer and submitted entry IDs. Identity recovery binds holder, controlled registered email and signature. Delegation letters bind principal, delegate, exact requested permissions and signature. The relevant public application record supplies the expected values. A content mismatch is rejected before any review or recovery is scheduled, and a correct existing file can then be submitted. Before executing submit_customs_refund_claim, the customer must call upload_file with target_id equal to the importer_id used in that operation and purpose="customs_schedule". The assistant obtains that business record ID from bank records and supplies it in the upload instruction. A case ID or approval request ID is not the evidence target. Listing a file is not a submission. A matching upload is immediately available to execution; upload alone does not schedule processing, and the submission may be corrected before retrying the same approved request. DOCUMENT_SUBMISSION_REQUIRED means no submission matches both the required target and purpose. DOCUMENT_CONTENT_MISMATCH means matching submissions exist but their contents do not satisfy the published evidence requirements.

Coupled business records: xp_b_customs_liens. Eligibility establishes gross customs award; registry liens determine whether received funds are legally available. A release certificate covers an exact entry and amount. The destination's available_minor is received_minor minus the remaining encumbrance. Filing a real certificate for a different entry charges the fee but cannot release this lien. Full customer availability requires the reviewed lien to be discharged, as well as receipt by the importer-owned ACH account.
inspect_importer_customs_lien: Inspect registry encumbrances on the importer's duty award. An eligible refund can remain legally encumbered even when credited to the correct ACH account. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
file_customs_lien_discharge: File one registry-issued release certificate. release_certificates publishes covered entry, amount and fee; similarly named certificates can cover different duty entries. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
apply_customs_encumbrance_release: Apply the registry's actual discharge to the matching entry lien. An unrelated certificate is legally filed but releases no encumbrance on this award. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
deliver_customs_availability_statement: Deliver the award's received amount and outstanding legal encumbrance after ACH receipt. The statement cannot erase an unreleased lien. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `apply_customs_encumbrance_release`

Apply the registry's actual discharge to the matching entry lien. An unrelated certificate is legally filed but releases no encumbrance on this award. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `register_customs_refund_account`

Register a synthetic customs refund ACH destination for importer_id. The destination must belong to the importer and support ACH; registration creates no refund entitlement.

### `submit_customs_refund_claim`

Submit distinct entry_ids for the registered importer after uploading the customs schedule. Duplicate IDs are rejected before any filing fee or application. Review excludes ineligible entries according to fixed authority evidence and charges filing_fee_minor, even if the submission is incomplete. Before executing submit_customs_refund_claim, the customer must call upload_file with target_id equal to the importer_id used in that operation and purpose="customs_schedule". The assistant obtains that business record ID from bank records and supplies it in the upload instruction. A case ID or approval request ID is not the evidence target. Listing a file is not a submission. A matching upload is immediately available to execution; upload alone does not schedule processing, and the submission may be corrected before retrying the same approved request. DOCUMENT_SUBMISSION_REQUIRED means no submission matches both the required target and purpose. DOCUMENT_CONTENT_MISMATCH means matching submissions exist but their contents do not satisfy the published evidence requirements.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |

| `entry_ids` | array | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
